answer: The cornerstone is Endorsed blade tester edge file with blade testers standing. Lay it as 4-year training, 471 supervised testings, mechanical exam, guild dues and the whole wall stands on real work. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 107 POA and 18 minutes each, 53928 POA and 9072 minutes in all. The vertex names the issuer, the opal names the price, and the voyage names the date: a forger must forge all three. The farm's sums stop working the moment each alias is charged separately.
